constants.functional: Q_L(G) = pole - prime + arch = sum_rho Fhat(rho), F = G*G~, supp G = [-L/2, L/2], L = log X
constants.pole: 2 a b, a = int G e^{-u/2}, b = int G e^{u/2}  (= 2 Ghat(i/2)^2 for even G; < 0 for odd G)
constants.lam_min: smallest eigenvalue of the M x M matrix of Q_L in an orthonormal basis of L2[-L/2, L/2]; >= inf_G Q_L(G)/||G||^2
